digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and command surface
propositions: Add new projects_store.py module to store and manage store-level project-to-repos mapping in .bridge_state/projects.json with version and legacy_default fields

Implement resolve_project(ticket, mapping) pure function that returns legacy_default for absent keys, None for explicit empty strings, project key for set values, and None when legacy_default is empty
Surface projects mapping operations as bridge projects subcommand group with list, set, and remove verbs integrated into CLI, library (_lib_ops.py), and MCP layers
Absent projects.json record reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default (fail-safe); malformed record raises an error; ensure-seed landing in dependent story 462d-8d84
set operation requires --repos argument (error if omitted); set --repos "" stores empty list; set on existing key replaces repos list idempotently without merging
Mapping writes must not mutate bindings.json or prev_snapshot.json; list tool is READ_ONLY in MCP; set and remove are write tools; help text and argparse metavar must both name projects verb
